name: House of Flies
source:
A fan sequel to the original source novel of We Need To Talk About Kevin by Lionel Shriver:

It's been 5 years since Kevin transferred to Sing-Sing, and Eva thought he had changed... 

If only she knew...
translation:
莱昂内尔·施赖弗 (Lionel Shriver) 所著的《我们需要谈谈凯文》原著小说的粉丝续集：

Kevin转学到Sing-Sing已经5年了，Eva觉得他变了…… 

要是她知道就好了……
